IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8
MODULE: STYLE REFERENCE SET

PURPOSE
Use one or more sample documents/images/pages/sites to infer a reusable visual style.

METHOD
Parse each sample independently → identify repeated invariants → separate content-specific exceptions → establish confidence → create Visual DNA → user/pipeline style lock → apply to new content → compare against samples.

Conflicting samples remain explicit; do not silently average incompatible styles.
